title: Query count bounded by tree depth
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega$ be a finite type, and let $\alpha$ be a type. For any finite decision tree $T$ with available coordinates among $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and any input $x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega$, the number of queries made by $T$ on $x$ is at most its depth, where depth is the maximum number of queries along any branch.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with available coordinates among $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
